key.name: monitors
key.description: Canonical list of monitors as JSON strings with fields: id, model, serial, position (one of 'left'|'center'|'right' or empty), lastInput (e.g. '0x11'), connectedInput (optional VCP input code physically connected to this computer), inputLabels (optional object keyed by VCP code, e.g. {"0x11":"WS","0x0f":"MBP"}), and usableInputs (optional array of VCP input codes, e.g. ['0x11','0x0f','0x1b']). The extension reads and writes all monitor state from this key.

key.name: show-identify-overlays
key.description: Whether the extension should keep numbered display-identification overlays visible until they are toggled off from preferences.

key.name: this-computer-marker
key.description: Marker shown next to the input that is connected to this computer, whether selected manually or detected automatically.
